name: Transformer Purchase Engineer
description: Purchase and design engineer at a distribution-transformer manufacturer in the Hosur–Bengaluru belt, sourcing CRGO mitre-core laminations. Visits on a desktop at work or on a phone between shop-floor calls, comparing laminators. Needs to see in seconds that MANZZA makes exactly what they buy (mitre step-lap, E&I, strip; CRGO/CRNO; thicknesses, grades, rating range), that it is a real, dependable Bengaluru supplier, and how to send a drawing for a quote.
frustrationTriggers: Has to scroll through a long animation before seeing what the company makes
Specifications (thickness, grade, rating range) buried in prose instead of a table
No visible phone, email or location — cannot tell if this is a real supplier
Quote form that asks for things before showing where to attach the drawing
Marketing language with no engineering facts
Tiny low-contrast labels that are hard to read on a shop-floor phone
positiveSignals: Products named in the trade's own terms (mitre core step-lap, E&I, strip; CRGO, CRNO)
A specification table with thickness and grade ranges
A direct 'Request a quote' path with drawing upload
Real contact details and a Bengaluru location
Product visuals that show the actual lamination geometry
cognitiveLoadFactors: Long pinned scroll sequences before content
Uppercase display type set in long multi-line headlines

sampleReactions: Good — CRGO 0.20 to 0.35 mm, that's what I buy.
Where do I upload the core drawing?
Nice animation, but I just need the rating range and a phone number.
